name: Aeterna
summary: Records your voice, stories and memories so family can keep talking with you later, starting on a free plan.
description: Aeterna is a life-story product: you record voice, wisdom and memories so family members can hear you later, including after you are gone. All listed software plans include AES-256 encryption, a private vault, unlimited story topics and mobile access; you can cancel anytime and memories stay after cancellation.

pricing.details: Free Forever; Storyteller 44 €/month; Family Legacy 142 €/month; Memory Booster 26 € one-time; optional Time Capsule hardware 1,339 €.
